title: Settings this run used
prefixes: RandomSeed, NTrees, Iqr*, Noise*, Holdout*, Clip*, Morgan*, Gnn*
description: Values the steps read rather than measure: the seed, the tree count, the schedule and grid of the networks, the outlier fence and the partition fractions.

title: Curation of the benchmark data
description: Record counts through the curation: the raw table, the duplicates, the two benchmarks and the sensitivity set.

title: Nested cross-validation of the four representations
prefixes: Morgan*, RdkitTwoD*, Sel*, N*, Outer*, Inner*
description: The main benchmark: accuracy of each representation over the outer folds, and how often the inner loop selected each architecture.

title: Paired comparisons between representations
description: Corrected paired t-tests between every pair of representations, their Holm adjustment, and the equivalence tests with their margins.

title: y-randomization
description: The four forms of the chance-correlation test: permuted response and pseudo-descriptors, on the architecture alone and on the whole procedure.

title: Augmentation and selection ablation
description: The hold-out experiments that reproduce the interventions of the original study on a classical learner, including the two leaky diagnostics.

title: Virtual screening and applicability domain
description: The FDA library funnel, the similarity domain with its threshold sensitivity, the conformal interval, and the candidates with their efficiency metrics.

title: Re-docking validation
description: Geometry of the re-docked crystallographic ligand that validates the docking protocol.

title: Docking and the consensus
description: Binding energies of the candidates, and the agreement between the model's ranking and the docking scores.

title: ADMET profile of the candidates
description: Predicted absorption and safety properties of the candidates, with the thresholds used to read them.

title: Default D-MPNN benchmark
description: The graph network with Chemprop's default hyperparameters on the shared outer folds, and its comparison with every classical representation.

title: Tuned D-MPNN
description: The variant whose hyperparameters are chosen by a hold-out search inside each outer training partition.

title: Stronger neural baselines
description: The pretrained CheMeleon model, the five-seed ensemble, the descriptor-augmented network, and the plain network on fingerprints.

title: Reproducibility of the neural benchmark
description: Spread of the benchmark score over repeated executions of the same code, which the graph models do not reproduce bitwise.

title: Scaffold-grouped re-run
description: The whole benchmark repeated on scaffold-grouped outer folds, and the drop from random folds for every model.

title: Outlier sensitivity
description: What changes when the two extreme potencies are kept: accuracy of every representation, and whether the ranking holds.

title: Audit of the original pipeline
description: The published pipeline reproduced and then repaired one leak at a time, with the score of every rung of the ladder.

title: Measured cost per step
description: Wall-clock cost of one training and of one complete outer fold, measured on the workstation without normalizing by thread count.
